question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in bold in the given sentence.

It is universally acknowledged that trees are **indispensable **to us.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Essential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"indispensable"** means something that is absolutely necessary or essential and cannot be done without. (अत्यावश्यक)

 
 
• **Example:** Water is indispensable for the survival of all living organisms.
 
 
 
• **"Essential"** refers to something that is absolutely necessary; extremely important. (अत्यावश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** Good nutrition is essential for maintaining a healthy body.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. Essential.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Unusual** (असामान्य): Not habitually or commonly occurring or done.

 
 
• **Example:** It is unusual for him to be late to meetings.
 
 
 
• **Rational** (तार्किक): Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.
 
 
• **Example:** He gave a rational explanation for his actions.
 
 
 
• **Fierce** (उग्र): Having or displaying an intense or ferocious aggressiveness.
 
 
• **Example:** The fierce storm caused widespread damage.
